title: Executable pilot rules
description: Mechanical rule mappings and separate contextual review.

rules.requirement: Inputs have associated labels and required semantics.
Invalid input has associated error text and aria-invalid.
Pending saves keep the submitted draft stable, prevent a second request and communicate busy state.
Rejected saves retain the edit and a retry reaches success.
Keyboard focus is visible and form submission works without a pointer.
Pilot controls remain within the viewport without horizontal overflow.
Rendered colors and nested component tokens come from the CSS authority.
Reduced motion stops dynamic decoration while retaining static SVG material.
Declared variants are rendered in typed consumer examples.
Review reading order, action priority, and task fit in the captured states.
